Node-style module resolution for the JS bundler. Resolves relative paths and bare specifiers via node_modules lookup with package.json exports / main field support.

Types

ResolveOpts = object
  extensions*: seq[string]   ## File extensions probed when the specifier has none.
  mainFields*: seq[string]   ## `package.json` fields consulted in order (after `exports`).
  conditions*: seq[string]   ## `exports`-map condition names matched in order.
  nodePaths*: seq[string]    ## Extra lookup roots, checked before walked-up `node_modules`.
  externals*: seq[string]    ## Bare specifiers left untouched (never resolved).
